Client.ProposalTitle: Growth Marketing System for Brightline Test Co
Client.ProblemText:
This is an internal test proposal, so the details below are illustrative. Brightline gets steady interest but the inbound arrives in unpredictable waves, and the follow-up lives in a notebook instead of a system.

The site is slow, the reviews are thin, and the ad spend is not pointed at anything measurable. None of it talks to each other.
Client.SolutionText:
Rebuild the website on a fast, search-ready foundation, then layer on a rotating monthly service so there is always one channel being pushed.

Everything reports into one place, so you can see what each dollar returns instead of guessing.
Client.AtGlanceServices: Website rebuild plus rotating monthly marketing (Meta Ads, Google Business Profile, or SEO)
Client.AtGlanceTimeline: Website live in 2 to 3 weeks, marketing starts right after
Client.ScopeItems:
• Complete website rebuild with mobile optimization and fast load times
• Service pages with clear pricing and service-area coverage
• One rotating marketing service per cycle from a fixed menu
• Monthly strategy call plus performance reporting
Client.TimelineItems:
• Week 1 to 2: website rebuild and launch
• Week 3: first marketing service goes live
• Monthly: review results, pick next cycle's focus
Client.InvestmentDetails: Pick the option that fits where Brightline is right now:
Client.InvestmentNote: Monthly fees are billed in advance at the start of each cycle. You can move between tiers with 30 days' notice.

Content.TrackRecord.intro: We build marketing infrastructure for service businesses. Everything we build is designed to run on its own with minimal upkeep.

caseStudies.text: A local restaurant went from 14 to 132 Google reviews in 60 days. That translated to $25K in new revenue.
A salon owner in Manhattan put $600 into Meta ads and pulled $36K in income within 3 months. 60X return.
We rebuilt a software company's site and repositioned their search strategy. Six months later they were #1 on Google for 7+ keywords.
